content: Official crate documentation verifies pdf-extract 0.12.1 can extract PDF text per page and docx-rs can parse DOCX, but current docx-rs development documents Rust 1.88 while Meetily declares Rust 1.77. A minimal compatible plan is pasted text and text files first, pdf-extract only after a golden-corpus and MSRV check, and bounded DOCX XML extraction using the already-resolved zip and quick-xml families instead of adopting the full docx-rs model immediately.
